literal: Men of Fu Fu's company—all displayed loyalty and constancy; otherwise how could painted likenesses and written registers be held precious?
idiomatic: Fu Fu and men like him all kept faith to the last; without such souls, of what worth would painted likenesses in the halls of fame, or their names in the annals, ever be?

literal: Appraisal: These generals alone preserved their honored names—without lapse, without forgetting—and so ended their days.
idiomatic: Appraisal: Only these generals kept their honored names unstained—no lapse, no forgetting—and lived out their days in that same steadfastness.

literal: Fu's sons and their like met this ill-starred hour; before the fierce wind blew, who could tell the tough grass?
idiomatic: Fu Fu's sons and men like them met an hour out of joint; before the gale came, who could tell which blade of grass would stand unbowed?

literal: The full text uses the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi (November 1972) as the base for collation.
idiomatic: The full text uses the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi (November 1972) as the base for collation.
